basics.name: Bastien Gaffet
basics.label: Engineering Student / Creative Builder
basics.summary: Engineering student with a passion for building systems where mechanics, software and design converge. Comfortable moving between embedded hardware and interface design, between algorithm logic and physical execution. Always looking for the intersection where things work well and feel right.

work.name: Robot J4
highlights: Designed and built a robotic arm playing Connect Four autonomously against a human opponent.
Minimax algorithm with custom heuristics for optimal decision-making up to depth 6.
Python + OpenCV pipeline for real-time board state recognition via camera feed.
Arduino UART serial link between the Python decision engine and the physical arm.

work.name: Classroom Construction, Ourika Valley
highlights: Volunteered in a village near Chicker to build an additional classroom for a school unable to self-fund construction.
On-site tasks: fabricating rebar from raw steel, stone-laying for foundations, trenching for toilet drainage, manual concrete mixing and slab pouring.
Produced the initial architectural plans for the new classroom in collaboration with the local development association.

work.name: Sports Club Board Member
highlights: Member of a sports club board (ESO Volley). Administrative management, event organisation and coordination between members and governing bodies.

courses: TIPE research on epoxy resin mechanical properties in composite structures under stress
